notes_for_editor: Location, elevation, removal year and registration are consistent across the three sources. The built year is disputed: 1932 on the register and firelookout.com, 1934 on Kemnow's listing, which describes a 10 by 10 ground house. The story reports both and does not pick one. Removed (register, Kemnow) versus destroyed (firelookout.com) is also reported as written. Two web searches found no other source for this site, so the story is short. The record has no staffing or fire information and none is in these sources.
